transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m… having trouble at work. I can’t really make myself go near the front windows or that part of the street anymore. I keep finding reasons to stay in the back, even though I’m supposed to be up front sometimes.
What is it about the front windows or that part of the street that makes you want to avoid it?

It’s just… that area. The front windows, and the street right there. I can’t seem to make myself go near it anymore, so I keep making excuses to stay in the back, even when I’m supposed to be out front.
Is there something specific that you're afraid of when you're near the front windows or that part of the street?

I don’t know if it’s one specific thing exactly. It’s just… being near those front windows, that stretch of street. I kind of freeze up and then I make some excuse to stay in the back instead, even though I know I’m supposed to be up there sometimes.
Is there something in particular that you're afraid might happen to you when you're near the front windows or that part of the street?
I don’t know… I just can’t make myself go near there anymore. The front windows, that part of the street. I end up making excuses to stay in the back, even though it’s part of my job.
Is there something outside the window or on that part of the street that you're afraid of?

Not really something I can point to, no. It’s more just that window area and that part of the street… I can’t make myself go over there anymore, so I keep staying in the back when I’m supposed to be up front.
Did something upsetting happen to you near the front windows or on that part of the street?

Yeah… something happened around there. I don’t really want to get into all of it, but since then I just can’t make myself go near the front windows or that part of the street. I keep finding reasons to stay in the back, even when I’m supposed to be up there.
Do you have panic or feel like you're going to have a panic attack when you're near the front windows or that part of the street?
I’m not sure I’d call it panic. I just get really uncomfortable and want to get away from there.
Is there something in particular that you fear will happen or something specific you fear when you're near the front windows or that part of the street?

I don’t know if it’s one specific thing I think will happen. I just… I can’t make myself go near the front windows or that part of the street anymore. I keep making excuses to stay in the back, even though I’m supposed to be up there for work.
Is your fear of being near the front windows or that part of the street related to something that happened there?

Yeah… it’s related to what happened there. That’s why I came in, I guess. I just can’t make myself go near the front windows or that part of the street anymore, and I keep making excuses to stay in the back even though I’m supposed to be up there.
Is there something specific about that area that you're afraid of or trying to avoid?

I don’t know… it’s just that spot. The front windows, and that part of the street. I can’t make myself go over there, so I keep finding reasons to stay in the back, even though I’m supposed to be up front for work.
Is what happened near the front windows or that part of the street something that could happen again?

Maybe. I don’t really know. I just know since it happened, I can’t make myself go near those front windows or that part of the street. I keep staying in the back, making excuses, even though I’m supposed to be up there for work.
Is there something specific that happened near the front windows or that part of the street that you're trying to avoid thinking about or remembering?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t really want to get into it. But since then I just can’t go near the front windows or that part of the street. I keep making excuses to stay in the back, even though I’m supposed to be up there for work.
Is there something specific that you saw or experienced during the event that happened near the front windows or that part of the street?

Yeah… the crash. I saw the glass come down. Sometimes it just pops back in my head, like when I’m setting up displays, and I can hear that bang again for a second. It feels like it’s happening right there.
Are you avoiding the front windows and that part of the street because you're afraid another crash might happen?

I guess… maybe partly. I don’t think it through that clearly. I just know I can’t make myself go near the front windows or that spot outside anymore. I keep coming up with reasons to stay in the back, even though I’m supposed to be up there for work.
Is avoiding the front windows and that part of the street more about not wanting to remember the crash or not wanting another crash to happen?

More not wanting to remember it, I think. I just… I can’t make myself go near those front windows or that part of the street now. I keep finding excuses to stay in the back, even though I’m supposed to be up there for work.
For how long have you been avoiding the front windows and that part of the street?
About two weeks… since that night the car came through the store window.
Has avoiding the front windows and that part of the street affected your work performance or relationships with others?

Yeah… it’s affected work. I had to leave in the middle of resetting the front window display because I just couldn’t finish it. I don’t know… now I’m worried I can’t really handle the parts of the job that are up by the storefront.
How long have you been unable to go near the front windows or that part of the street?
About two weeks now… since the car came through the store window on that overnight shift.
